claim: In full-year 2025, Tesla saw revenue increase 3% from a year earlier.
summary: As of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04, Tesla had not yet reported audited full-year 2025 results (typically released late January 2026). Without tools or post-cutoff filings, the claimed 3% full-year revenue increase cannot be verified from pre-cutoff knowledge alone.

sub_claims.stated_text: revenue increase 3% from a year earlier
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 precedes Tesla's full-year 2025 earnings/10-K release; Q4 and full-year 2025 revenue not established in available knowledge without tools, so increase of 3% cannot be confirmed or refuted.
